## Follow-up Comments
Test the timeout that NewClient passes to genai.NewClient.
`808-812`: **📐 Maintainability & Code Quality** | **🔵 Trivial** | **⚡ Quick win** **Test the timeout that `NewClient` passes to `genai.NewClient`.** `TestRequestTimeout` covers only `requestTimeout`. Both `NewClient` tests return before `genai.NewClient` runs, so no test reads `HTTPOptions.Timeout`. Removing the timeout wiring, meaning both the `timeout` declaration and the `HTTPOptions` field, leaves the suite passing. Removing only the `HTTPOptions` field fails to compile, because `timeout` becomes unused. Moving the `ClientConfig` literal into a helper does not close this gap. The call site in `NewClient` can still drop the field. Cover the call site instead: - Add a package-level variable that holds the SDK constructor, initialized to `genai.NewClient`. Call it from `NewClient`. - In a new test, enable AI and set a non-empty API key for the Gemini provider. Replace the variable with a fake that records the `*genai.ClientConfig` it receives. Restore the original with `t.Cleanup`. - Call `NewClient`. Assert that the recorded `HTTPOptions.Timeout` equals the configured duration. [Open the source location](https://github.com/cloudposse/atmos/blob/090c433250301fb12c0f19b56278b33078471433/pkg/ai/agent/gemini/client_test.go#L808-L812)

Add a replaceable package-level constructor initialized to genai.NewClient, have NewClient call it, and add a test that configures Gemini with AI enabled and a non-empty API key, captures the received client configuration, restores the constructor with t.Cleanup, and asserts HTTPOptions.Timeout matches the configured duration. ```

## Follow-up Comments
Add a NewClient test for the unset timeout.
`827-827`: ** Trivial** · **Maintainability & Code Quality** · **Quick win** **Add a `NewClient` test for the unset timeout.** `TestNewClient_PassesConfiguredTimeoutToSDK` sets `TimeoutSeconds: 7`, so it covers only the configured path. `NewClient` sets `HTTPOptions.Timeout` on every call. A change that sets the timeout only when `TimeoutSeconds` is positive still passes that test. `TestRequestTimeout` does not catch it either, because it calls only the helper. Add a test that leaves the setting unset. It should assert that the default timeout reaches the SDK config.
Suggested test
```diff assert.Equal(t, 7*time.Second, *got.HTTPOptions.Timeout) } + +func TestNewClient_PassesDefaultTimeoutToSDK(t *testing.T) { + var got *genai.ClientConfig + orig := newGenaiClient + newGenaiClient = func(_ context.Context, cc *genai.ClientConfig) (*genai.Client, error) { + got = cc + return &genai.Client{}, nil + } + t.Cleanup(func() { newGenaiClient = orig }) + + atmosConfig := &schema.AtmosConfiguration{ + AI: schema.AISettings{ + Enabled: true, + Providers: map[string]*schema.AIProviderConfig{ + "gemini": {ApiKey: "test-key"}, + }, + }, + } + + client, err := NewClient(context.Background(), atmosConfig) + require.NoError(t, err) + require.NotNil(t, client) + require.NotNil(t, got) + require.NotNil(t, got.HTTPOptions.Timeout) + assert.Equal(t, base.DefaultRequestTimeout, *got.HTTPOptions.Timeout) +} ```

**Clamp the Gemini request timeout before multiplying by `time.Second`.** `requestTimeout` multiplies `TimeoutSeconds` by `time.Second` without an upper bound. Values above 9223372036 wrap around `time.Duration`. A value in roughly 9223372037 to 18446744073 gives a negative timeout, and genai then sets no request deadline. A value near 18446744074 gives a sub-second deadline.
Suggested fix
```diff --- "a/pkg/ai/agent/gemini/client.go" +++ "b/pkg/ai/agent/gemini/client.go" @@ -74,13 +74,18 @@ }, nil } +import "math" + // requestTimeout returns the HTTP request timeout, honoring ai.timeout_seconds. func requestTimeout(atmosConfig *schema.AtmosConfiguration) time.Duration { - if atmosConfig != nil && atmosConfig.AI.TimeoutSeconds > 0 { - return time.Duration(atmosConfig.AI.TimeoutSeconds) * time.Second - } + if atmosConfig != nil && atmosConfig.AI.TimeoutSeconds > 0 { + if int64(atmosConfig.AI.TimeoutSeconds) > int64(math.MaxInt64/time.Second) { + return time.Duration(math.MaxInt64) + } + return time.Duration(atmosConfig.AI.TimeoutSeconds) * time.Second + } return base.DefaultRequestTimeout } // SendMessage sends a message to the AI and returns the response. func (c *Client) SendMessage(ctx context.Context, message string) (string, error) { ```
The same unchecked conversion also exists in `cmd/ai/ask.go`, `cmd/ai/exec.go`, `pkg/ai/analyze/analyze.go`, and `pkg/ai/tui/chat_approval.go`. Those paths create their own request contexts, so a shared helper would fix them together.
